_comment: Timeouts are well above Cypress' defaults on purpose. defaultCommandTimeout governs the retry window for cy.contains/should, and 10s is not enough headroom on a loaded developer machine -- it produced failures that moved to a different spec on every run. Raising it hides nothing: a genuinely broken build never resolves, so it still fails, just later. responseTimeout/pageLoadTimeout are raised above Cypress' 30s/60s defaults because the test environment compiles packs on demand (webpacker.yml test: compile: true). A cold public/packs-test makes the first cy.visit() of a run wait ~60s for webpack, which surfaced as a random ESOCKETTIMEDOUT in whichever spec happened to run first. yarn test:cypress:gate precompiles first, so this is belt-and-braces; a genuinely dead server still fails, just later.
_comment2: integrationFolder and supportFile are set explicitly only so this Cypress 4 config keeps finding the specs after they moved from cypress/integration to cypress/e2e and support/index.js to support/e2e.js -- those are the Cypress 10+ default locations. Both keys disappear when this file becomes cypress.config.js.
